metadata.title: A relation-incidence proof of Tohăneanu's low-exponent supersolvability conjecture
metadata.description: Every finite central free hyperplane arrangement over a characteristic-zero field whose nonzero exponents are 1 or 2 with at most one 3 is supersolvable. This research note proves the full conjecture in Tohăneanu's Oberwolfach contribution using linear-relation formality, rank-two counts, a forced K4 incidence core and modular terminal-pencil extensions. The paper credits the earlier all-2, tree, rank-three and modular-pruning results and acknowledges Ferudun's matching October 12, 2026 preprint. The verification archive preserves the October 4 PR candidate and dated disclosure records, source/priority audits and reproducible exact computational diagnostics. No exhaustive first-priority or independent-development claim is made. AI tools were used extensively in solving, writing and verifying the work. This is an unrefereed preprint; internal AI reviews do not constitute independent human peer review.

publication_receipt.title: Forward generation does not ensure GNS descent: an explicit continuous counterexample

metadata.title: Forward generation does not ensure GNS descent: an explicit continuous counterexample
metadata.description: Generation by an observed algebra and its forward translates does not ensure descent through a general dilation's fixed expectation-GNS representation. This research note constructs a unital separable, injective, point-norm continuous C*-dilation of the two-state exponential relaxation semigroup, exactly forward-generated by C2. Its GNS image is M2, and an explicit nonzero positive kernel element leaves the kernel at every positive time. This refutes the concrete generation-only proposal in Skeide's 2009 module-approach problem. The clock/evaluation/cocycle mechanism is credited to Burgarth, Facchi and Hillier; the negative phenomenon is also a short unstated corollary of their earlier clock model. Finite-unitary and first-derivative antecedents are credited to Dive, Mintert and Burgarth and to vom Ende. No new general dilation method or literature-first priority is claimed. Stronger minimality conditions and extension after separately imposed kernel invariance remain outside the result. The verification archive preserves the original PR candidate, independent analytic audits, primary-source attribution evidence and reproducible exact checks. AI tools were used extensively in construction, writing and verification. This is an unrefereed preprint; internal AI reviews do not constitute human peer review.

tracker_row: Forward generation does not ensure GNS descent: an explicit continuous counterexample. Skeide's first module-approach problem, OWR 2009 pp. 542–543; catalogue ID 30001184 / OWR-3392-012. publication_receipt.title: A qualitative pre-Schwarzian improvement for real schlicht functions

metadata.title: A qualitative pre-Schwarzian improvement for real schlicht functions
metadata.description: For normalized univalent functions with real Taylor coefficients, the classical centered pre-Schwarzian disk can be strictly shrunk at every fixed nonreal point, uniformly over the class. Its radius remains sharp on the real diameter. This research note gives a qualitative answer to Hayman–Lingham Problem 6.86 using classical second-coefficient equality, reflection symmetry of the equality domains, and compactness. The gap is uniform on compact nonreal sets. Real disk automorphisms reduce the unknown sharp radius to one variable, and exact examples give lower bounds and two limiting obstructions to a global positive gap. No explicit upper-gap formula, sharp numerical radius, general extremizer or full variability region is determined. No new general method, historical firstness, exhaustive novelty clearance or current-openness guarantee is claimed. The bounded priority audit retains unresolved original-source limits for Jenkins (1960) and Aleksandrov–Popova (1973). Related earlier linear extreme-point and argument estimates are distinguished from the nonlinear derivative quotient. The verification archive preserves the original candidate and controlling scope note, independent analytic/source and priority audits, exact algebraic controls, and explicitly uncertified numerical replays; full third-party source scans are excluded. AI tools were used extensively in development, verification, source investigation and writing. This is an unrefereed preprint; internal AI reviews do not constitute human peer review.
